meta.description: Overall pass-rate (%) results for SkillLift and baselines on WildClawBench (60 tasks) and SkillsBench (87 tasks), 3 rollout seeds, mean per-task best evolved-skill score. Evolving baselines share the same seed skills and receive 2x SkillLift's token budget.
meta.wildclawbench_model_note: WildClawBench uses GPT-5.4 and SkillsBench uses GPT-5.4-mini, aligning with the official implementations.

token_efficiency.description: Average cumulative tokens required to first reach the 0.9 quantile of total pass-rate score on SkillsBench, expressed as a multiple of SkillLift's cost (SkillLift = 1.0x).
